ctaHeading: Ready to Create Your Custom Furniture in Tottenham?
aboutText: At Studio Daam in Tottenham, we specialise in small batch and custom furniture. Each piece starts as a sketch on paper and is handmade from carefully selected timber. Using traditional techniques, we craft unique furniture with personality, blending design and wood's natural charm for your home.
servicesText: We offer a range of furniture services including custom design, handmade construction, and restoration. All work is done in our Tottenham workshop using traditional methods to ensure quality and character.

services.title: Custom Furniture Design
services.desc: We design bespoke furniture tailored to your space, starting with sketches and collaborating with you throughout the process.

services.title: Handmade Timber Furniture
services.desc: Each piece is handmade from selected timber, using traditional techniques to ensure quality and character in every item.

services.title: Console & Hallway Tables
services.desc: Specialising in console tables such as the HZL Hallway Console, meticulously crafted to enhance entryways and living spaces in Tottenham homes.

services.title: Mirrors & Vanity Pieces
services.desc: Crafting custom mirrors and vanity tables like the EMA-Leaner and TRU Vanity, with meticulous attention to detail and design.

services.title: Furniture Restoration
services.desc: Restoring and refinishing timber furniture to bring new life to old pieces, preserving their original charm and character.

services.title: Small Batch Production
services.desc: Producing limited runs of furniture designs, ensuring each batch maintains high standards of craftsmanship and uniqueness.
